name: llm-world
description: An interactive timeline of large language model releases, month by month.

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run build:export && npm run smoke
scripts.clean: rm -rf models companies timeline families milestones analytics compare latest data-quality methodology taxonomy changes sitemap.xml robots.txt api llm-releases.csv .build-check
scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'git hooks enabled — pre-push now runs npm run check'
scripts.enrich: node scripts/archive-sources.mjs --save --write && node scripts/hf-metadata.mjs --write && node scripts/attribute-facts.mjs --write && node scripts/detect-modalities.mjs --write && node scripts/detect-undisclosed.mjs --write && node scripts/state-reasons.mjs --write
